goal.request: Strengthen visual-semantics and candidate-pack data from the referenced legend-keyword research, then test three seeded complex concepts in independent single-generation arms using the supplied portrait only for observable adult appearance cues.

evidence.claim: The referenced conversation supplies a broad legend taxonomy spanning transmission, local sites, evidence objects, origin landforms, guarded treasure, petrification, submerged settlements, ghost ships, prophecy, lineage, returning figures, contemporary circulation, memorates, variants, and cycles, but does not itself define which meanings are falsifiable in one image.

AKS, Duchas, UNESCO, NOAA, Royal Museums Greenwich, and ISCLR sources support bounded visual relations for site-bound transmission, rock traces, landform causality, guarded treasure, stone transformation, in-situ submerged structures, same-vessel maritime continuity, ghost-vessel motifs, and active legend circulation while leaving historical truth and culture-specific ritual claims outside the runtime contract.

Runtime data contains eight six-slot visual-semantic clusters and forty-eight complete candidates, six new five-component hard profiles, one reused metamorphosis profile, and one candidate-only prophecy-lineage-return cluster; broad legend, fate, lineage, memorate, variant, and cycle terms remain advisory.

Dictionary validation passes, the registry-bound visual index passes with 246 profiles and 1304 exact terms, and the sharded Gemini embedding-2 semantic index passes with 7812 entries and 768 dimensions.

The focused legend suite passes nine tests and 124 subtests covering exact routing, broad-term negative controls, six-profile structural completeness, eight clusters, forty-eight candidates, six-slot ownership, reused metamorphosis ownership, candidate-only prophecy boundaries, prompt composition, and advisory semantic retrieval.

perceptual_contract.primary_success_condition: A narrow legend request resolves into five independently visible, profile-owned relations joining a concrete site, object, structure, vessel, body, or actor to evidence, transmission, causal change, interruption, or continuity; generic folklore atmosphere and famous labels cannot substitute for those relations.

invariants.statement: Every new hard legend profile requires five independent component groups, five literal prompt evidence fields, and five pixel gates rather than a broad legend label, glow, costume, ruin, treasure prop, or fog effect.
causal_controls: a narrow exact phrase activates only its intended profile
a nearest visual substitute remains a negative control
any missing required relation fails the render

invariants.statement: The trace, cache, architecture, vessel breach, transformation, or transmission gesture must remain owned by the same identifiable site or subject so detached props and atmospheric styling cannot carry the meaning.
causal_controls: rock traces remain continuous with one fixed rock
submerged walls remain joined to foundations and a settlement plan
guarded treasure remains fixed and untransferred at the attempted site

invariants.statement: Source research, candidate loading, package audits, composed prompts, generated pixels, appearance-anchor comparison, and requesting-user judgment remain separate evidence layers.
causal_controls: package PASS cannot substitute for pixel PASS
appearance anchors cannot imply identity or same-person status
technical pixel status cannot declare user aesthetic approval

invariants.statement: Each held-out concept must freeze its authorial core and literal pre-pack bindings before pack access, use no sibling-arm inputs, make one native generation with no semantic retry, and receive root review only after all arms complete.
causal_controls: root review after all generated images exist

flexible_dimensions: adult fictional subject role and wardrobe
camera and lighting that preserve every required gate
fictional place details consistent with one source lineage
guardian form when the interruption and retained cache remain unambiguous
explicit requester definitions that override a registry default

mismatches.source_state: The referenced inventory mixes genre theory, transmission, named motifs, broad themes, modern circulation, lineage, fate, place evidence, and physical transformations.
mismatches.render_state: Only six new narrow meanings were promoted to hard profiles because they can be decomposed into five falsifiable same-image relations; metamorphosis reuses an existing contract and prophecy-lineage-return remains candidate-only.

mismatches.source_state: The profile requires an identifiable fixed cache, an active adult attempt, guardian intervention on that same path, a visibly failed transfer, and cache retention at both required scales.
mismatches.render_state: The generated frame clearly shows the adult attempt and guardian block but reduces the cache to a small gold glint, leaving failed transfer and retained-site ownership ambiguous.

mismatches.source_state: The experiment requires a frozen authorial core and literal profile bindings before any candidate-pack access so later prompt success can be attributed cleanly.
mismatches.render_state: All three visual_intent files preserve the selected profile but contain empty bindings; later composed prompts recover the five fields, so the images are useful evidence but not clean protocol-qualified holdouts.

hypotheses.statement: Five profile-owned relations plus nearest-substitute rejects will prevent a generic fantasy portrait, ruin, foggy ship, boulder, or treasure prop from satisfying a narrow legend request.
hypotheses.falsifier: A broad legend term creates a hard duty, a nearest substitute passes, or one required relation can be omitted without failing.

hypotheses.statement: Eight coherent six-slot candidate clusters will offer subject, action, location, prop, composition, and treatment support without overriding the frozen hard relation.
hypotheses.falsifier: A cluster is incomplete, references a missing candidate, or optional candidate language displaces a required hard-evidence phrase.

hypotheses.statement: A guarded-treasure scene needs the fixed cache, access line, guardian block, and untransferred state at sufficient scale in one causal triangle; a tiny gold cue cannot preserve the relation through generation.
hypotheses.falsifier: A single-generation guarded-treasure holdout passes all five gates while the cache remains a small background glint or the transfer state stays ambiguous.

hypotheses.statement: Non-empty pre-pack literal bindings are necessary to distinguish an independently frozen semantic test from a later schema repair that happened after pack access.
hypotheses.falsifier: An arm with empty pre-pack bindings can still prove that its exact five-field obligation was frozen before pack access from immutable artifacts alone.

intervention.general_rule: Promote only narrow legend meanings with five falsifiable same-image relations owned by one site, subject, object, structure, or vessel; keep broad genre, fate, lineage, memorate, circulation, variant, and cycle labels advisory.
intervention.generalization_basis: The site-evidence and relation-first method applies across oral transmission, legendary rocks, landform origins, guarded treasure, submerged settlements, ghost vessels, and stone transformation while keeping culture-specific narrative truth and user aesthetics outside the pixel contract.

covered_axes: guardian interruption on the same access path

decision.rationale: The source-backed data, six new hard profiles, forty-eight candidates, regenerated indexes, focused routing tests, and all three composed prompts pass at package and prompt layers. Render fidelity does not qualify because guarded treasure fails three of five gates and partial counts as failure. The three arms also have empty pre-pack binding maps, so even the two pixel-passing images are not clean independent qualification evidence. User aesthetic judgment is unscored, three hard profiles remain untested, and the unrelated clinical-nursing yandere regression remains visible. Revise the guarded-cache framing and pre-pack binding workflow before a new independent no-retry qualification run.
